The company Lightigo Space s.r.o. (est. 2022, www.lightigo-space.com) is a subsidiary of Lightigo s.r.o. (est. 2019, www.lightigo.com) with a focus on technology transfer from academia to industry and its consequent commercialization. Moreover, Lightigo Space fosters further development of prototypes with expertise in optics, optomechanics, electronics and firmware, control and data processing software, spectroscopy, and machine learning. The company closely cooperates with the Laboratory of Laser Spectroscopy (CEITEC Brno University of Technology, www.libs.ceitec.cz). Thus, the major focus of the company is on analytical chemistry (e.g., prospecting of lunar regolith) by using namely the Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy (LIBS) and Raman spectroscopy.
The team of Lightigo Space has already been involved in several space-related projects. The first major project was the development of advanced optics for hyperspectral detection of meteorites from LEO (VESNA payload, SLAVIA ambitious cubesat mission) in cooperation with SAB Aerospace. Currently, the company is involved in the development of a fiber laser for LiDAR (LLD payload, TROLL cubesat mission) that is funded by private resources of the TRL Space company. The major achievement of the company is the project ISRA (In-Situ Resource Analyzer) which has been funded by ESRIC and ESA. This project will support the business and technical feasibility of a LIBS payload implemented on landers/rovers for prospecting of lunar regolith.

entityDescription:
The ESRF - The European Synchrotron Radiation Facility - is the most intense source of synchrotron-generated light, producing X-rays 100 billion times brighter than the X-rays used in hospitals. These X-rays, endowed with exceptional properties, are produced at the ESRF by the high energy electrons that race around the storage ring, a circular tunnel measuring 844 metres in circumference.

Each year, the demand to use these X-ray beams increases and near to 9000 scientists from around the world come to Grenoble, to “beamlines”, each equipped with state-of-the-art instrumentation, operating 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

Thanks to the brilliance and quality of its X-rays, the ESRF functions like a "super-microscope" which "films" the position and motion of atoms in condensed and living matter, and reveals the structure of matter in all its beauty and complexity. It provides unrivalled opportunities for scientists in the exploration of materials and living matter in many fields: chemistry, material physics, archaeology and cultural heritage, structural biology and medical applications, environmental sciences, information science and nanotechnologies.

Thirty years ago the ESRF made history as the world’s first third-generation synchrotron light source. Today, the ESRF continues to lead the way with the Extremely Brilliant Source (EBS), a brand-new generation of high-energy synchrotron, improving X-ray performances of brilliance and coherence once again by a factor of 100. This new concept, based on innovative technology, paves the way for a new standard of synchrotrons around the world. ESRF-EBS will contribute to tackling global challenges in key areas such as health, environment, energy and new industrial materials, and to unveiling hidden secrets of our natural and cultural heritage through the non-destructive investigation of precious artifacts and palaeontological treasures.

We produce special optical elements e.g. for satelite laser communication.

We automate the production of nanostructured fibres and flat lenses to enable the development of novel technologies and products utilising beam shaping and photonic phenomena. This key technology is crucial for addressing immediate needs in healthcare, communication, detection, and cybersecurity markets with significant impacts on disease treatment; quality of life; environmental monitoring; reliability, safety, and data transmission speed. Our objective is to improve existing machine from TRL7 to TRL9 and begin reliable serial production meeting industry standards. The main source of revenue will come from series production of preforms and optical elements, while also offering R&D services to customers and partners whose products lead to serial production or enable SYGLASS technology to enter new markets. This approach will benefit in the future in the form of high-volume orders and will educate the market about the capabilities of our services. The current SYGLASS demonstrator (TRL7) has shown promising results, manufacturing elements that were evaluated in laboratories and by early customers. The new machine will incorporate a series of improvements based on the requirements of the initial target markets. Each of the requirements has been extensively researched and improvements to the machine will be introduced according to the coherent technological plan we have developed. New flat gradient lenses and nanostructured core fibres setups are being developed for use in space, cybersecurity and healthcare markets. Those optical elements will be used not only as demonstrators of the technology but also as early SYGLASS applications and core products with proprietary technology aimed for sale and licensing.

entityDescription: Aerial Tools ApS (AT) is a Copenhagen based deep tech start-up that develops a revolutionary Vertical Take-Off and Landing (VTOL) Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) with a patented payload interface unit. The advantage of this type of drone is that it does not need a large area to reach its operational height or any supporting mechanism like run aways or catapults. By tilting the rotors, it flies forward taking advantage of its aerodynamics. Thereby, it can continuously fly for a long time (4 hours/flight opposed to 20-40 mins for most standard drones) without battery replacement or charging. AT’s drone platform can cover large and remote areas with high data quality acquisition. The patented payload interface unit is designed to plug and play any advanced specialized sensor as well as multiple sensors at the same time to collect data more efficiently and precisely than current drone solutions. The aim is to improve aerial data acquisition in B2B commercial inspections and monitoring. Therefore, the product is designed to improve the overall operational capacity, providing a better end user customer experience, reducing operational mapping costs, and facilitating better and quicker customers decision making. AT services depend on the customer needs. To offer customers exactly what fits into their operational needs, we provide tailored data acquisition, processing, and analysis. Our final goal is to create an impact by developing scalable, accessible, and sustainable solutions.

Timezyx is set out to develop Digital Twin technologies to enhance infrastructures’ resilience under extreme climate conditions.

ParaLoon develops inflatable / unfoldable "parabolic balloon" concentrator photovoltaic (CPV) structures to collect both photonic and thermal solar energy for applications in space, on earth and on other planets. 
Applications in space would include satellites, space stations, habitats or mission vehicles. On earth, these structures could be used for remote areas, campsites or mobile applications.

entityDescription:
MultiPull One is a mobile, flexible, pocket-sized training station that makes heavy and bulky steel weights superfluous and makes you completely independent of gravity. An electric motor converts the energy from a high-performance battery unit into up to 80 kg of pulling force - and the power of your muscles back into electrical energy. The device itself weighs only 5 kg. The battery stores excess energy charges your mobile devices and can be easily removed for use as a power bank. With the help of the versatile mounting options, you can train not only at home, but also in the park on a tree or a lamppost, whether for endurance or highly efficient strength training.
In addition, MultiPull One will be the world's first fitness device that allows users to train together remotely, feeling each other. Interactive live challenges in the community, such as digital tug-of-war, are made possible by the app, which is the central control unit. With new features like cooperative or competitive mini-games, an automatic training plan and a detailed health monitoring for sport enthusiasts or astronauts we are revolutionising the fitness market and inspiring people in a new way for healthy sport and exercise. As a future extension of the portfolio, the next step will be to develop a lightweight version for an especially portable use in space or everyday life
